review_text: The gameplay mechanics are smooth and combat is incredibly satisfying!
Stunning graphics, immersive world design, and a captivating soundtrack.
One of the greatest RPGs ever made. The story and character development are top notch.
Fantastic multiplayer experience with friends, highly recommended!
Great performance, zero stutters, and runs locked at 60 fps even on modest hardware.
Masterpiece! The storyline had me hooked from start to finish.
Awesome DLC updates, active developers who actually listen to community feedback.
Excellent level design and challenging boss fights that feel rewarding.
Graphics are breathtaking and ray tracing looks incredible on PC.
Very addictive gameplay loop, already poured over 100 hours into this game.
Beautiful art style and intuitive controls made this an instant favorite.
Outstanding voice acting and emotional depth throughout the campaign.
Smooth matchmaking, balanced weapons, and rewarding progression system.
Best indie title of the year! Truly innovative puzzles and design.
Remarkable optimization, fast loading times, and tons of replay value.
Exciting open world exploration with secrets hidden everywhere.
Flawless combat animations and deep customization options.
A huge improvement over the previous sequel in every single aspect.
Super fun co-op mode, haven't laughed this hard playing a game in years.
The soundtrack alone is worth purchasing the game. Pure art.
Brilliant physics engine and emergent gameplay moments keep it fresh.
Constant crashes to desktop make the game completely unplayable.
Terrible optimization, severe frame drops and lagging even on high-end GPU.
Worst launch ever. Filled with game-breaking bugs and broken quests.
Greedy microtransactions and aggressive pay-to-win mechanics ruin the fun.
Boring repetitive missions, lifeless open world, and bland characters.
Horrible servers, constant disconnects, and laggy multiplayer matches.
Disappointing storyline, clunky controls, and frustrating camera angles.
Refunded after 30 minutes. Complete cash grab with false marketing.
Unresponsive controls, sluggish movement, and sluggish combat feel awful.
Overpriced DLC for cut content that should have been in the base game.
Stuttering mess on PC with memory leaks and audio glitches.
Extremely toxic community and developer does nothing against cheaters.
Shallow progression, meaningless side quests, and wasted potential.
The AI enemies are completely broken and walk into walls endlessly.
Awful voice acting and dialogue feels like it was written by an amateur.
Save files got corrupted twice, lost 40 hours of progress.
Microtransactions everywhere you look, feels like a mobile game on console.
Terrible hit registration in competitive multiplayer matches.
Game won't even launch past the splash screen without crashing.
Total downgrade compared to the trailers shown before release.
Empty multiplayer lobbies, dead player base, and zero new content.
